routed_authority.name: PMC Disaster Management Cell & Ward Tree Officer
routed_authority.role: Emergency public safety response, road barricading, and stabilization/tree felling hazard mitigation

legal_citations: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975: Section 7(b) (Mandatory preservation of public safety and prevention of hazardous tree collapse)
Disaster Management Act, 2005: Section 30 & 34 (Emergency mitigation of imminent structural threats to life and property)
DANGEROUS_LEANING_FALL_RISK.prayer_en: Dispatch emergency response team immediately to inspect structural stability, secure pedestrian perimeter, and take preventive arboricultural action before collapse.
DANGEROUS_LEANING_FALL_RISK.prayer_mr: धोकादायक झुकलेल्या झाडाची तात्काळ पाहणी करून आपत्ती व्यवस्थापन पथकामार्फत योग्य ती सुरक्षा उपाययोजना व कारवाई करावी.

routed_authority.name: Pune City Police Control & PMC Tree Officer
routed_authority.role: Immediate physical intervention to stop active tree destruction; seizure of cutting equipment under Section 21

legal_citations: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975: Section 8(1) (Absolute statutory prohibition on tree felling without prior Tree Authority sanction)
Maharashtra Tree Act 1975: Section 21 (Cognizable offence punishable with fine and imprisonment; mandatory police intervention for in-progress felling)
ILLEGAL_FELLING_IN_PROGRESS.prayer_en: Dispatch immediate police and Tree Officer patrol to halt ongoing tree cutting, demand production of statutory Form C Tree Authority permit, and register FIR under Section 21 if unauthorized.
ILLEGAL_FELLING_IN_PROGRESS.prayer_mr: सुरू असलेली बेकायदेशीर वृक्षतोड तात्काळ थांबवून संबंधितांवर वृक्ष संरक्षण कायद्याच्या कलम २१ अन्वये गुन्हा नोंदवावा.

routed_authority.name: Tree Officer & PMC Tree Authority (Ghole Road)
routed_authority.role: Post-facto inspection, inquiry on Form C permit validity, compounding/legal prosecution

legal_citations: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975: Section 8(1) & Section 8(3) (Statutory public notice mandate)
Maharashtra Tree Act 1975: Section 21 (Penalties for unauthorized felling and mandatory compensatory afforestation)
ILLEGAL_FELLING_COMPLETED.prayer_en: Conduct on-site investigation of fresh tree stump, verify whether Form C felling permit was legally sanctioned with mandatory public objection window, and initiate penal action under Section 21 if illegal.
ILLEGAL_FELLING_COMPLETED.prayer_mr: तोडलेल्या झाडाच्या जागेची पाहणी करून अधिकृत परवानगी नसलेवर संबंधितांवर कायदेशीर दंडात्मक कारवाई करावी.

routed_authority.name: PMC Ward Garden / Horticulture Department
routed_authority.role: Trimming/removal of dangerously suspended branches obstructing traffic or high-tension power lines

legal_citations: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975: Section 7(b) (Maintenance and removal of hazardous limbs to ensure public transit safety)
HAZARDOUS_BRANCH.prayer_en: Deploy hydraulic skylift / pruning van to trim and remove the suspended broken limbs posing immediate hazard to pedestrians and vehicles.
HAZARDOUS_BRANCH.prayer_mr: नागरिकांच्या सुरक्षेसाठी लटकलेली व तुटलेली धोकादायक फांदी तातडीने कापून रस्ता मोकळा करावा.

routed_authority.name: Superintendent of Gardens & Tree Authority PMC
routed_authority.role: Arboricultural disease inspection, anti-termite treatment, and scientific tree conservation

legal_citations: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975: Section 7(d) (Statutory duty of the Tree Authority to treat and restore diseased or pest-infested trees)
DISEASE_PEST.prayer_en: Direct horticulture specialist to inspect pest/fungal infection, apply necessary biocides/treatment, and restore tree health under Section 7(d).
DISEASE_PEST.prayer_mr: झाडाला लागलेली कीड व रोगावर उद्यान विभागामार्फत औषध फवारणी व योग्य ते उपचार करण्यात यावेत.

routed_authority.name: PMC Road Department & Ward Tree Officer (Garden Dept)
routed_authority.role: De-concretization of suffocated tree bases and restoring mandatory unpaved breathing basins

legal_citations: National Green Tribunal (NGT) Principal Bench Directives: Mandatory 1-meter radius de-concretized soil basin around all urban tree bases
Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975: Section 7(a) (Preservation of tree root ecosystem)
ROOT_CONCRETIZATION.prayer_en: Excavate concrete/asphalt within 1-meter radius of the tree base in compliance with NGT guidelines to prevent root suffocation and eventual collapse.
ROOT_CONCRETIZATION.prayer_mr: झाडाच्या बुंध्याभोवती घातलेले सिमेंट काँक्रीट हटवून एनजीटीच्या नियमानुसार १ मीटर जागा मातीसाठी मोकळी करावी.

routed_authority.name: PMC Garden Department (Tree Ambulance) & Ward Encroachment
routed_authority.role: Extraction of hammered nails, removal of advertising boards, freeing strangled cambium layer

legal_citations: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975: Section 2(c) ('to fell a tree' includes in any way damaging a tree) read with Section 8
High Court of Bombay Orders & PMC Public Directives: Hammering nails, metal brackets, and commercial hoarding defacement on trees is a punishable offense
NAILS_BOARDS_CABLE_STRANGULATION.prayer_en: Deploy Tree Ambulance / Garden team to extract all hammered iron nails, remove illegal advertising hoardings, detach tight cables strangling the cambium, and initiate penal action against advertisers.
NAILS_BOARDS_CABLE_STRANGULATION.prayer_mr: झाडावर ठोकलेले खिळे, जाहिरात फलक व बांधलेल्या तारा तात्काळ काढून झाडाची हानी करणाऱ्या संबंधितांवर कारवाई करावी.

routed_authority.name: PMC Tree Authority (Ghole Road)
routed_authority.role: Verification of pruning permission and canopy restoration inspection

legal_citations: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection & Preservation of Trees Act, 1975: Section 8(1) (Prohibition on heavy crown mutilation without sanction)
UNAUTHORIZED_PRUNING.prayer_en: Verify whether pruning activity was conducted in accordance with scientific guidelines and Tree Authority sanction.
UNAUTHORIZED_PRUNING.prayer_mr: झाडाच्या फांद्यांची अवाजवी छाटणी नियमानुसार झाली आहे का याची पाहणी करावी.
